frozen_scope_note: B0 freezes the rules and pins the named DCMLab subcorpus. B1 performs corpus retrieval and gate calibration under these rules; no encoder rule changes after freeze without a new authorization.

global_rules.anchoring: absolute heptatonic set S is represented as anchored mask S - phase; phase is the declared per-corpus root/tonic pc
global_rules.determinism: completion tie-break = max overlap with the key collection, then smallest anchored mask
global_rules.fallback_policy: Every non-primary branch increments a named counter. B1 receipts must emit all counters. Silent fallbacks are prohibited.
global_rules.heptatonic_completion: Given chord pcs C, key collection K, and phase p: if C is a subset of K use K; otherwise choose the absolute heptatonic set S (represented by a census mask shifted by p) that contains C, maximizes |S intersect K|, and has the smallest anchored mask integer; if no census set contains C, use K and count mask_no_superset.
global_rules.non_harmonic_policy: DCMLab @none rows are non-harmonic events: skipped and counted as non_harmonic_rows. B1 must declare carry-forward vs skip before calibration.
global_rules.pedal_policy: DCMLab pedal column is not merged into chord pcs in B0; B1 may add a declared pedal-overlay variant.
global_rules.phase_policy: one declared phase rule per corpus; no implicit defaults
global_rules.triad_underdetermination: A triad/7th does not determine a heptatonic mask. Completion uses the declared per-corpus key context and the deterministic rule above; there is no runtime guessing.

substrate.representation: node = mask@phase; mask is anchored (bit 0 set); sounding pcs = {(pc + phase) mod 12 for pc in mask}; every mask must be a member of the 462-mask census
